description: The numerical codes of logically valid equality-only sentences form a computably enumerable set, using the effective empty signature and the actual natural-deduction proof checker.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EffectiveTheories.equality_validity_search_enumerable :
  REPred fun n =>
    ∃ A,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.emptySignature A =
          n ∧
        ∅ ⊨ᵇ A
